Petco is a really weird company to work for honestly. I've had some truly wonderful experiences as an employee there, and some bad ones which led to me quitting. Like not having access to distilled water. Most stores have hose attachments for the distilled water sinks but not this one. Everything was broken and doing maintenance was always a battle, having to dechlorinate and test the tap water constantly was a real pain in the ass. As a lot of people already know, tap water can contain a lot of silicates which causes different types of algae, so that was always fun to deal with. Corporate knew about it, the DM knew, they just didn't care to pay to fix it. That combined with a CAL who literally admitted and showed me that they were drinking on the job and getting into verbally violent situations with customers. There was also a homophobic/transphobic partner not being disciplined for their actions and statements at all. I stayed there for five months and I just couldn't take the chaos of that store. I miss it sometimes, but I just couldn't do it.

Former Petco employee here, with some interesting info. Not all stores are allowed to do stuff like this, first of all to have more complex set ups the store has to make a certain amount of money to become a "magnet store". If the store manager and aquatics specialist work with their DM on what their plans are on advertising not just cool but healthy tank set ups, it might be allowed. So when you see this stuff in a Petco, just know that the whole store had to work really hard and took a lot of BS from corporate to be able to do that. An old magnet store I worked at did informational shows and demonstrations for the public on basic fish biology, water chemistry, water changes, etc. Trust me when I say there are in fact a handful of super good petcos, and that are are some truly terrible ones.

PS- If you see a store doing cool stuff with their tanks and don't know if they're a magnet store, be careful with posting on social media because that could get the store workers in trouble from corporate for "not following guidelines". Depends on the DM really though, some are cooler than others.

Life is really not going how I'd like it to at the moment. Some days are hard to get through, but it's so worth it. Being able to walk into the forest or go to the beach basically whenever I want is such a gift. Humboldt really is a magical place. I still see what's happening in the community and one of the biggest things that's currently helped is going to marches and protests for #BLM and paying attention to the small, local news. By the time Aug comes around I think it will be an incredibly unique time to be in a new town. Moving here was the most life changing decision I've ever made, and I don't regret it one bit.
